coach.title: Personal Coach
coach.subtitle: Ask, adjust, stay on track
coach.greeting: Hi {name}! I know your plan, your history and how this week is going. Tell me what's up and I'll adjust your training.
coach.voiceUnsupported: Voice input isn't supported in this browser. Type instead.
coach.voiceError: Voice input failed. Try again or type.
coach.doneRecovery: Done. Today is a recovery day. Come back refreshed.
coach.doneEquipment: Done. I removed that equipment from your profile and swapped {n} exercises in your next workout. Later sessions are updated too.
coach.doneLimitation: Done. I'll avoid those movements in upcoming sessions and swapped what I could.
coach.doneRebuild: Done. Your upcoming weeks are rebuilt from your latest preferences and history.

replies.difficulty: Let’s make the session easier. I can lower the load or reps and give you more rest between sets.
replies.equipment: You can still train. I can swap the dumbbell exercises for options that fit the equipment you have.
replies.time: Let’s use those 20 minutes for the main exercises. I can trim extra sets and accessory work.
replies.progress: You’ve finished {done} of {planned} planned workouts this week. Open Progress for your training history and records.
replies.todayDone: You’ve already trained today. If you feel like moving, a short walk or some gentle mobility is enough.
replies.todayNext: Your next workout is {workout}. It takes about {minutes} minutes.
replies.todayEmpty: There’s no workout scheduled. Open your training preferences to choose days for your plan.
replies.tired: Take a recovery day or choose a lighter session if you feel up to it. A recovery day keeps your streak.
